items.title: Melba Liston — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I went to work at the insurance company, Adams . . . Yeah. I went there.

ctx.x: Not no steady. Once in a while. Just a night or two. Then I quit that, and I went to playing again, and that didn’t – no, it’s not working. And so I went to work at the insurance company, Adams . . .
